lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr20N4 (reduced formula Cr5N) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr centers with 10–12 geometric neighbors, including a close-packed-like local arrangement, while N centers have 9 Cr neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and edge-sharing between 12-vertex Cr polyhedra and between 10-vertex Cr polyhedra, though these patterns are not asserted to be exclusive.
